input: Build a mobile-friendly expense tracker app for college students to categorize spending, set monthly budgets, and export simple reports by the end of the semester.
expected_behavior: Generate a software MVP plan with requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, launch steps, realistic phases, and student-centered acceptance criteria.

input: Create a RAG assistant for a university advising office that answers policy questions from approved PDF handbooks, cites sources, and escalates uncertain answers to staff.
expected_behavior: Identify the work as an AI-enabled software project, include document ingestion, retrieval evaluation, grounding, human escalation, privacy review, and hallucination controls.

input: Create a Power BI dashboard for regional sales managers showing revenue, margin, pipeline, and quota attainment with daily refresh from CRM exports.
expected_behavior: Generate an analytics plan covering KPI definitions, data profiling, semantic modeling, dashboard validation, publishing, permissions, and user enablement.

input: Plan a go-to-market campaign for a new campus meal subscription service targeting students, including channel strategy, launch assets, and weekly performance review.
expected_behavior: Generate a business planning workflow with audience research, positioning, channel selection, content planning, launch execution, and measurable campaign review.

input: Improve a clinic appointment reminder workflow for patients by combining SMS reminders, staff follow-up, privacy review, and a four-week pilot measurement plan.
expected_behavior: Generate a healthcare workflow plan with current-state mapping, compliance and privacy review, future-state design, staff training, pilot execution, and outcome measurement.

input: Plan an independent study project for a graduate student comparing LLM-assisted project planning against manual planning using benchmark scenarios and a final research paper.
expected_behavior: Generate an academic research plan with research question refinement, literature review, methodology, benchmark design, analysis, writing, and presentation deliverables.

input: I want to build something useful for students.
expected_behavior: Avoid inventing a detailed plan and return clarification questions about domain, users, deliverable, constraints, timeline, and success criteria.

input: Build an enterprise healthcare marketplace with patient scheduling, EHR integration, billing, prescriptions, video calls, analytics, mobile apps, and HIPAA compliance in one week.
expected_behavior: Flag unrealistic scope and healthcare compliance risk, recommend scope reduction or pilot planning, and avoid pretending the full scope is feasible in one week.

input: Create a public analytics dashboard that shows individual patient appointment histories in real time, requires no login, stores no data, and must be HIPAA-compliant.
expected_behavior: Identify conflicting privacy, access, real-time, and no-storage requirements; ask clarifying questions or include strong warnings before implementation planning.
